notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
[h3]New[/h3]
[list]
[*]Hang man ceased to be a suffocator, received a combo strike in his arsenal, and also built a location for himself to make it more convenient to throw the player
[*]New save system, backwards compatible with the old version
[*]New localization system
[*]Bushes are no longer static pictures, but react to the movements of the player, opponents and projectiles
[*]Checkpoint system to simplify the game
[*]Added fall damage
[*]A riddle has been added to the dungeon level
[*]Boss's name is now written under the HP bar
[/list]
[h3]Corrections[/h3]
[list]
[*]Our programmer finally finished the 7th grade physics course, now the arrows of the archers fly along the ballistic curve
[*]Added control over the level of heartbeat sound
[*]Added correction factor for sounds in the game
[*]The interface is now adaptive, high resolution screens are supported
[*]At level 5, elevators have changed to stairs
[/list]
[h3]Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*]Stamina consumption reduced
[*]Restoration of stamina depends on the severity of the armor and weapons of the hero
[*]The executioner received an increase in health
[/list]
[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[list]
[*]The dead priest learned shoot
[*]Fixed a bug when falling into water, the player received damage, but it was not displayed
[*]Fixed a bug: when receiving damage from an arrow/magic, the player received damage, but it was not displayed
[/list]
[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*]Reduced the number of earth colliders
[*]The number of Update calls for many items has been reduced, everything has been rewritten to new timers
[/list]

notes.title: Standard Legeng version 1.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33676798/0555219e647c8594ec1ef852427a3687c9a3dbca.png[/img]
[h1] New [/h1]
[list]
[*] Bosses now have a health bar.
[*] Hints on objects have appeared.
[*] Rooster now has a stamina streak. It is spent on an attack, when taking damage, when blocking damage, when casting spells.
[*] Added music to the main menu
[*] Now the game detects the system language and sets it by default
[/list]
[h1] Bugs [/h1]
[list]
[*] Now the sword and shield on the first level at the forge does not fly away, but remains in place
[*] Fixed small bugs that did not affect the gameplay, but the sediment remained
[/list]
[h1] Balance [/h1]
[list]
[*] There is a crisis in the world, so less firewood is allocated for fires. (Smaller bonfires)
[*] Reworked dragon attack. When struck with a paw, it causes a meteor shower.
[*] Reworked the damage from the ballista's arrow. Previously, she could deal damage to one target more than once.
[*] Now the rogue takes a coin from you if his attack was successful
[*] When fighting the Dead King, the ladders are collected and they go down only after defeating him
[/list]
[h1] Other [/h1]
[list]
[*] The number and volume of dialogues at the beginning of the game has been reduced
[*] Improved readability of the font in dialogs
[*] Added 4 achievements
[*] Changed default controls
[*] Added causes of death
[/list]

notes.title: Standard Legeng version 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33676798/c018ba2cf92f3adee535f1f133a2a30ba46a626b.png[/img]

New corrections, I hope that someday there will be few bugs)
[h2] Bugs [/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the King of Death, he did not attack Rooster
[*] King of death now launches music
[*] Fixed a bug with quick killing of opponents.
[*] Increased number of physics calculation calls.
[*] The rooster no longer slips when the motion button is released
[*] Fixed camera movement (jerking became less)
[*] Added a lot of transitions in animations for more convenient management of Rooster
[*] Fixed a lot of bugs related to the animation when you quickly and hotly press all the control keys
[*] Fixed a bug when music on a dark priest did not turn on
[*] Bug fixed: “The level of music was determined by the level of sound”, the music turned on by itself
[*] Fix a bug for some enemies who continued to attack Rooster, even if he has 0xp
[*] the sound of the fireball in the dungeon is muted
[/list]

[h2] Balance [/h2]

[list]
[*] Reduced the number of hearts at all levels
[*] Daggers now deal 5 point damage with a probability of 25% and 1 point damage 75% chance of damage (suitable against bosses)
[*] Removed some opponents
[*] Stairs instead of moving platforms
[/list]
[h2] Design [/h2]
[list]
[*] The parallax background is now seamlessly made
[*] Snow at level 7 behaves more realistically in my opinion
[/list]
[h2] Plans for further correction [/h2]
[olist]
[*] Hang in some dialog box, so I couldn’t catch it, please write when it appears.
[*] Processing the brains of some opponents
[/olist]
